evidenceClaimContract.assessmentWarning: High/moderate/low/very low are editorial confidence labels unless a source explicitly used a formal grading method. Never label an internal assessment as formal GRADE unless the process was actually performed.
evidenceClaimContract.rule: No ingredient receives one global efficacy verdict. Each claim is outcome-, population-, formulation-, protocol- and timeframe-specific.

doseProtocolContract.rule: Dose fields remain unavailable unless directly supported by reviewed sources. A dose used in a study is not automatically a personal recommendation.

antiDopingWarning: Not identified on the current WADA list is not a guarantee of permission, safety or contamination-free status. Check current rules, metabolites, sport and product batch.
